# Version 4.150.4
> **GPU glyph and stencil correctness** · Released September 21, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.150.4) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.150.4)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.150.4/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.4/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.150.4 corrects GPU glyph-atlas tracking and shared stencil-clear coordinates.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Correct glyph-atlas generation tracking** — Prevents a partial glyph-vector regeneration from marking earlier, potentially evicted glyph locations as current. ([#5113](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5113))
- **Shared stencil attachments use native coordinates** — Tracks stencil clears in backend-native coordinates when render targets with different surface origins share an attachment. ([#5083](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5083))
- **Windows HarfBuzz binaries pass BA2007** — Corrects the compiler-warning configuration that caused BinSkim BA2007 failures in applications consuming HarfBuzzSharp.NativeAssets.Win32. Native exports and shaping behavior are unchanged; other existing BinSkim warnings are unaffected. ([#5123](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5123))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.4

Windows native assets correct the warning configuration that triggered BinSkim BA2007. HarfBuzz remains at native version 14.2.1 with unchanged shaping behavior and exports.
